sectors.name: Technology
themes: AI infrastructure demand is structurally boosting memory/storage chipmakers (MU, WDC, SNDK) as hyperscalers ramp up capex, creating durable earnings momentum.
Indonesia's tech sector remains undervalued relative to global peers, offering catch-up potential as local digital adoption and cloud migration accelerate.
US rate-cut expectations are re-rating high-growth tech stocks (TRON, MLPT, NBIS) with long-duration cash flows, a trend likely to persist if inflation moderates.
sectors.ai: Aggressive buying in memory/storage (MU, WDC, SNDK) and high-growth names (TRON, MLPT) signals a risk-on rotation into tech, likely driven by AI demand and US rate-cut expectations. Indonesia's tech underperformance vs. US suggests local laggards may catch up; overweight memory-linked plays and avoid overextended momentum names.

Divergent monetary policy between Indonesia (stable rates) and the US (tightening) favors ID financials as local liquidity remains supportive for lending and asset quality.
sectors.ai: Indonesia financials outperformed the US sector, driven by strong local demand and positive momentum in smaller-cap names like TIFA and PADI. Focus on domestic-oriented lenders and fintech plays, as they benefit from rising credit penetration and digital adoption, while US exposure remains a drag.
